segments.title: Hype Train Cold Open: Train Puberty & Sub Marathon
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers an extended freestyle on 'train puberty' involving self-penetration metaphysics, estrogen/testosterone, and hellish freedom while thanking a massive sub wave from Tam Tran; Pepito and Peter Gibbon interject.

segments.title: News Desk: Venezuela, Maduro, Marco Rubio & January 6 Anniversary

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Cookie vs. Cream — The Oreo Debate
segments.notes: Crum argues the cookie is superior (dunkable, structural, bonding exercise with ex-wife); Munch champions the cream via a self-founded super PAC; Crum suffers a muscle spasm mid-argument and concedes the segment.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Cat Nose Massage, Love Spell for Dad, Video Aspirin
segments.notes: Jeb demonstrates a cat-calming thumb-on-nose technique, performs a handwritten love spell (folded, runed, eaten) to win his dead father's affection, and guides a 'video aspirin' breathing/nostril exercise that summons an unsettling calm.

segments.title: Zombie Dick Clark Interview: Undead New Year's Grievances & Spectral Pig Ears
segments.notes: A zombified Dick Clark complains about missing another New Year's, reveals sow ears from spectral pig slaughter, claims to fuck with his mind across 16 dimensions, and freestyles over a Bone Thugs beat before departing.

segments.title: Military Elite Robot / Plug Guy: Dimensional Plug Battle & Orifice Proliferation
segments.notes: A self-declared supreme military robot engages in escalating plug/orifice one-upmanship, manufacturing millions of orifices and plugs across 16 dimensions, culminating in a screaming assimilation cascade before Case ends the segment.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid to Ricky Peacock
segments.notes: Case, Pepito, and Peter Gibbon debrief the 'plug life' chaos; Pepito sees 14 dimensions; raid to Ricky Peacock playing Tabula Rasa.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a two-week hiatus to a chaotic New Year broadcast: Hype Train monopolizes the cold open with a metaphysical 'train puberty' saga; the news block covers US-Venezuela oil talks, Maduro's kidnapping, Marco Rubio's Cuba saber-rattling, and Case's purge-day platform of arresting the Trump administration; chat news features a Glasgow trans celebration, Pentagon letters to a Toronto sex shop, and the QAnon Shaman renouncing Trump; Chet Guy the Science Eyes analyzes glute morphology and a $300 FDA-cleared taint zapper; Munch & Crum debate Oreo anatomy until Crum spasms out; Jeb Nogget demonstrates cat massage, a love spell for his board-trapped father, and a hypnotic 'video aspirin' routine; Zombie Dick Clark airs grievances about missing New Year's and freestyles with spectral pig ears; a self-declared supreme military robot escalates a plug/orifice battle to dimensional absurdity before a raid to Ricky Peacock.
